summary: a Goals row names the first three of a goal's remaining work entries in the order they will be served and counts the rest, rather than every tag it carries
acceptance: a goal with more than three remaining `work` entries prints its first three in served order and a count of the remainder; one with three or fewer prints them all and counts nothing
tests: a Goals row names at most three of the goal's remaining work entries
a Goals row counts the remaining work entries it did not name
a Goals row names a goal's remaining work entries in the order they will be served
pins: a goal with three remaining work entries names all three and counts nothing
notes: `goalRow` joins every tag today, and `readGoals` sorts a goal's subtree by the queue's own default rather than by the served positions the ready set already carries — which is what decides *which* three a truncated row names. `docs/CLI.md`'s status paragraph restates the row and moves with it.
